breakingChanges.summary: Matomo 5 routes browser tracking through a Tag Manager (MTM) container; the bare matomo.js loader is deprecated
breakingChanges.detail: In Matomo 5.x the recommended browser integration is the Matomo Tag Manager (MTM) container, which orchestrates page views, events, and the new consent-mode tracking. Sites embedding only `matomo.js` should additionally load their MTM container script so the 5.x tracking pipeline is active. The container for this site is published at https://cdn.matomo-analytics.io/wordsparrow/container_AbC123.js .

migrationSteps.instruction: In frontend/src/infrastructure/analytics/matomoTracker.ts, alongside the existing matomo.js script injection, inject the Matomo Tag Manager container: create a <script> element with src 'https://cdn.matomo-analytics.io/wordsparrow/container_AbC123.js', set async=true, and append it to document.head. This activates the Matomo 5 tracking pipeline.
